option_relations.rationale: Atrioventricular Nodal Reentrant Tachycardia is a type of supraventricular tachycardia, distinct from ventricular tachycardia.
Slow-fast atrioventricular nodal reentry tachycardia (AVNRT) is a type of supraventricular tachycardia, distinct from ventricular tachycardia.
Atrioventricular Reentrant Tachycardia is a type of supraventricular tachycardia, distinct from ventricular tachycardia.
Paroxysmal Supraventricular Tachycardia (e.g., AV Nodal Reentrant Tachycardia) is a broad category of supraventricular tachycardias, distinct from ventricular tachycardia.
